description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Blasting Station and Dragonback Assault trigger, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Blasting Station and Bladewing's Thrall trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing's Thrall trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
